cases.customer_question: How should multiple product models be handled when creating a new Bluetooth SIG Product Listing?
question_variants: Can multiple models be entered during new registration?
Is only one model allowed in Product List?
How do I add derivative models?
Product List management for multiple models
cases.actual_issue: The customer wanted to understand whether Bluetooth SIG rules limit a new registration to a single product model and how derivative models should be handled.
cases.plain_english_explanation: A new Bluetooth SIG registration requires at least one model to be entered into the Product List. However, the registration is not restricted to a single model forever. Additional compatible models can be added later through Product List maintenance.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant explained that a new registration requires at least one Product List entry. Although multiple models are not strictly prohibited during registration, the recommended practice is to complete the initial registration with a primary model and then add additional models afterward using the Product List addition workflow.
cases.decision_logic: Initial registration and Product List maintenance are separate activities. Since Product List corrections can be cumbersome after submission, adding additional models after successful registration is often the safer process.
cases.final_recommendation: Complete the initial registration using a primary model and add additional derivative models through the Product List management process after registration completion.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrect Product List entries may require later correction requests and create unnecessary registration administration effort.
